subject: general
question: Which institute is responsible for the development of the 'Investor Information and Analytics Platform' in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Madras**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras developed the Investor Information and Analytics Platform (IIAP) in 2024**.
 
• The platform was **launched by Union Minister Rajeev Chandrasekhar in February 2024. **
 
• **The IIAP was developed by researchers at the Centre for Research on Start-up**s and Risk Financing (CREST) at IIT Madras. 
 
• The platform is intended to help entrepreneurs, startup founders, and young people who want to build their own services, devices, and platforms. 
 
• The **IIAP is intended to strengthen India's startup ecosystem. **
